description: Rank every insurer, model and deductible for one person by the full yearly cost for 2027 (premiums plus the bills they pay themselves). Returns the best options, the best deductible, the break-even point, the worst case and the saving against their current insurance.

current_insurer.description: Name of the current insurer, e.g. "Helsana"

current_monthly_premium.description: What they pay today per month for basic insurance

gp_visits.description: Family doctor visits per year (about CHF 150 each)

limit.description: How many options to return, default 5, best per insurer

municipality_bfs.description: BFS number from find_postcode, only needed if the postcode covers several municipalities

specialist_visits.description: Specialist or therapy sessions per year (about CHF 280 each)

works_8h_per_week.description: Works at least 8 hours a week for one employer. If true, accident cover is left out because the employer covers it

yearly_health_costs.description: Expected doctor bills per year in CHF. If missing, estimated from the visit counts below

name: compare_insurance
title: Compare basic insurance 2027
